I'm CTO and co-founder of Coffee AI, where we build AI tools for UK trades contractors, and an incoming DPhil student at Oxford in the Intelligent Earth CDT.

My research background is in machine-learned interatomic potentials: my Master's thesis at Oxford fine-tuned MACE models for halide perovskites, and I contribute to [autoplex](https://github.com/autoatml/autoplex).

These days I think about equivariant GNNs, ML inference infrastructure and GPU kernels. This site is a public record of what I'm learning and building.
